record.name: Demolitionist
record.description: Demolitionists are experts in explosives—breaching defenses, collapsing fortifications, and controlling the battlefield through calculated detonations.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Master of explosive mayhem, controlling the battlefield with precision and fury.

progression_tree.description: You gain expertise in two skills of your choice that require Intelligence (Investigation) checks, such as Perception or Thieves' Tools.

You can use your action to set up a detonation timer on an explosive device, allowing you to cancel the detonation if need be. The device must have a visible countdown timer or some other clear indication of when it will explode.
When you deal damage with an explosive device, the area around the target is affected by a shockwave, knocking creatures prone and potentially disrupting enemy formations.
You gain the ability to target specific parts of a structure, such as a wall or a door, when using an explosive device.
You gain expertise in two skills of your choice that require Intelligence (Thieves' Tools) checks, such as Sleight of Hand or Disguise Self.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a precise stance, feet shoulder-width apart, with the explosive device at the ready
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Emitting a pulsating aura of blue and orange flames, symbolizing the mastery over destructive forces

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A skilled Demolitionist stands amidst a battlefield, surrounded by destruction and chaos, radiating an aura of fury and control
